claims: Jack Nicklaus has six Masters tournament wins in 1963, 1965, 1966, 1972, 1975, 1986.
Tiger Woods has five Masters wins in 1997, 2001, 2002, 2005, 2019.
Arnold Palmer has four Masters wins in 1958, 1960, 1962, 1964.
Jimmy Demaret has three Masters wins.
Sam Snead has three Masters wins.
Gary Player has three Masters wins.
Nick Faldo has three Masters wins.
Phil Mickelson has three Masters wins.
Only three players have defended their Masters title successfully.
Jack Nicklaus defended his Masters title successfully in 1965-1966.
Nick Faldo defended his Masters title successfully in 1989-1990.
Tiger Woods defended his Masters title successfully in 2001-2002.
Jack Nicklaus won his sixth Masters title at age 46 in 1986.
Tiger Woods won his first Masters title at age 21 in 1997.
